title: One in three teens 'experienced problematic use' of Meta apps: closing remarks in social media trial | Fortune
summary: Meta, the parent company of Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp, is on trial in New Mexico for allegedly misleading users about the safety of its platforms for children and prioritizing profits over safety. The case involves claims of inadequate protection against harmful content and failure to enforce a minimum user age of 13.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a strongly negative sentiment due to the serious allegations against Meta regarding the safety of children on its platforms and the company's alleged prioritization of profits over user safety.
